newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-May aluminium output down 0.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-May aluminium output down 0.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Russia produced 1.19 million tonnes of primary aluminium in the first five months of 1997, down 0.3 percent from the same year-ago period, Interfax news agency quoted the Alyuminiy consultancy as saying on Friday.

Tajikistan produced 75,700 tonnes in January to May this year, down 12 percent on the first five months of last year. Ukrainian output rose 6.9 percent year-on-year to 40,400 tonnes in the first five months of 1997.

PRIMARY ALUMINIUM OUTPUT AT MAIN RUSSIAN PLANTS JAN-MAY 1997
Alyuminiy also said alumina production in the Commonwealth of Independent States fell 1.6 percent in the first five months of the year to 1.83 million tonnes.
Russia produced 920,100 tonnes of the total, down 2.3 percent from January-May 1996.

The Nikolayev (Mikolayiv) alumina refinery in Ukraine produced 370,000 tonnes in the first five months of 1997, down 5.6 percent year-on-year. The Zaporozhye works produced 86,000 tonnes, down 2.2 percent year-on-year, Interfax said.
Kazakhstan's Pavlodar refinery produced 454,000 tonnes from January to May 1997, 3.5 percent above year-ago levels.
